title: Highly improved photocurrent of a flexible MoS2 photodetector via a backside Al metal mirror and its in- and outward folding states
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34979-34984
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA00459K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hyewon Yoon, Seongin Hong
The photocurrent of a flexible MoS2 photodetector was significantly improved by attaching an Al metal mirror on its backside. In-folding state, the Al metal mirror acted as a concave mirror, further boosting the photocurrent.
